narrative.overview: This source-derived specification is normative only for /[locale]/projects and its PortfolioProject presentation. Other routes retain their existing design. The user approved the photographic direction, then requested smaller headings and imagery, less whitespace and more projects together.
keyCharacteristics: Real project photography, visible captions and restrained gold links.
A charcoal opening followed by a warm-white, three-project desktop collection.
Flat rectangular surfaces, compact spacing and inherited site typography.

rules.name: The Restrained Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold marks interaction and fine rules; project photography remains the dominant visual material.

rules.name: The Compact Collection Rule
rules.body: Preserve source order while grouping three projects per desktop row. Do not enlarge this route into a full-height opening.

dos: Do keep this specification scoped to the projects index.
Do preserve project order, visibility, covers and localized URLs from src/data/projects.ts; show the first project once and count only the remaining collection.
Do retain translated visible names, keyboard focus, RTL direction and reduced-motion behavior.
Do reuse existing cover assets through getImageUrl; their provenance remains in src/data/projects.ts. This redesign creates no raster assets.
donts: Don't apply this route's palette or composition to other pages without a separate approved change.
Don't add invented project metadata, new fonts, rounded card shells or decorative shadows to this route.
Don't describe source inspection as browser, mobile, test or production-build proof.
